english: Have you been taking the medicine for treating anxiety called benzodiazepines for three days?

english: Have you been taking the medicine for treating migraines called Naramig for three days?

english: When it hurts, does the pain move to your groin, between your stomach and your thigh?

english: Did you have indigestion? Indigestion is when your stomach hurts, sometimes because you ate too much.

english: Has it been bleeding for several months?

english: How many years have you been taking nitroglycerin, a medicine to treat angina?

english: You must take five pills for ten days

english: Has your poo been coming out in many pieces instead of staying together for one hour?

english: Have you been taking the blood-thinner medicine called Arixtra for more than two days?

english: Does your head hurt every few weeks?

english: Are you confused?

english: Have you been taking the medicine to help with seizures called Depakene for three days?

english: Have you had an MRI of your uterus?

english: Have you been taking the anti-inflammatory medicine called Voltaren for several weeks?

english: Does your head always hurt on the same side?

english: You must put in two to four drops for two days

english: Have you had a scan of your hip? A scan helps doctors see inside your body without surgery.

english: Does the pain in your stomach spread toward your neck?

english: Have you been taking medicine to help with constipation for more than one year?

translation: ክልተ ዝዕጠን መድሃኒት ሓደ ግዜ ንመዓልቲ ካብ ቁሩብ ደቓይቕ ክሳብ ቁሩብ ሰዓታት ክትገብር ኣለካ

english: You must wash your whole body with the lotion for a few weeks to a few months
translation: ካብ ቁሩብ ሰሙናት ክሳብ ቁሩብ ኣዋርሕ በዚ ፈሳሲ ሙሉእ ነብስኻ ክትሓጽቦ ኣለካ

english: Does your head hurt more when you sneeze?
translation: ዕንጥሸው ክትብል ከሎኻ ቃንዛ ርእስኻ ይውስኽዶ?

english: How many days have you been taking medicine for your diabetes?
translation: ክንደይ መዓልቲ ይገብር ምውሳድ ካብ ትጅምር ናይ ሺኮር ሕክምና?

english: Did you take beta-blockers today?
translation: ሎማዓንቲ መድሃኒት ቤታብሎኮን ዶ ወሲድካ?

english: Have you ever had a scan of your head? A scan helps doctors see inside your body without surgery.
translation: ስካንር መርመራ ናይ ርእሲ ጌርካ ዶ ትፈልጥ?

english: Have you been taking the medicine for treating migraines called Naramig for several days?
translation: መድሃኒት ናራሚግ ካብ ገለ ማዓልታት ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Have you been taking the medicine to help with constipation called Movicol for a long time?
translation: መድሃኒት ሞቪኮል ካብ ነዊሕ ጊዜ ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Does your head hurt in the back of your head?
translation: ቃንዛ ናይ ርእስኻ ኣብ ድሕሪ ርእሲ ድዩ?

english: Have you been taking medicine to lower your blood pressure for one year?
translation: መድሃኒት ኣንጻር ደም ብዝሒ ካብ ሓደ ዓመት ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Have you been taking the blood-thinner medicine called Liquemine for one hour?
translation: መድሃኒት ሊከሚን ካብ ሓደ ሰዓት ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Do you take the antibiotic called Zithromax?
translation: ትወስድ ዶ መድሃኒት ዝይትሮማክስ?

english: How many months have you been taking the blood-thinner medicine called Arixtra?
translation: መድሃኒት ኣሪክስትራ ክንደይ ወርሒ ይገብር ምውሳድ ካብ ትጅምር ?

english: Do you take vitamins?
translation: ትወስድ ዶ ቪታሚን?

english: Have you had surgery on your testicles?
translation: መጥባሕቲ ናይ ኣብ ፍረ ነብሲኻ ጌርካ ትፈልጥዶ?

english: We are going to take very detailed images of your back. To do this, you will lie down in a tunnel that makes noise.
translation: ዝተራቐቐ ስእላዊ መርመራታት ናይ ሕቖ ክንገብር ክንግደድ ኢና ፣ ነዚ ንምግባር ደቂስካ ኣብ ሓደ ቱኔል ድምጺ ዝገብር ክትኣቱ ኢኻ

english: Has your poo been a light color for several days?
translation: ካብ ገለ ማዓልታት ኣትሒዙ ብሩህ ኮይኑ ቀልቀልካ?

english: Have you been taking the antibiotic called Ciproxin for more than one hour?
translation: መድሃኒት ሲፕሮክሲን ካብ ሐደ ሰዓት ንላዕሊ ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Does it hurt here?
translation: ኣብዚ ቦታ የሕመካዶሎ?

english: Do you take the antibiotic called Furadantin?
translation: ትወስድ ዶ መድሃኒት ፉራዳንቲን?

english: Did you take the diuretic medicine called Aldactone recently?
translation: መድሃኒት ኣልዳክቶን ወሲድካዶ ኣብ ቀረባ ጊዜ?

english: Have you been taking a treatment for skin lesions for two days?
translation: መድሃኒት ናይ ቆርብት ቁስሊ ካብ ክልተ መዓልቲ ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Have you had an ultrasound scan of your ankle? An ultrasound scan helps doctors see pictures of the inside of your body.
translation: ኤኮግራፊ መርመራ ናይ ዓንካር ዓንካሪቶ ጌርካ ዶ ትፈልጥ?

english: Have you been taking medicine to help your stomach only starting today?
translation: መድሃኒት ናይ ጮጎራ ካብ ሎመዓልቲ ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Has your poo been normal for two days?
translation: ካብ ክልተ መዓልቲ ኣትሒዙ ከም ልሙድ ኮይኑ ቀልቀልካ?

english: Has your poo been soft for more than one week?
translation: ካብ ሓደ ሰሙን ንላዕሊ ኣትሒዙ ልስሉስ ኮይኑ ቀልቀልካ?

english: for several weeks?
translation: ካብ ብዙሕ ሰሙናት ኣትሒዙ?

english: Have you been taking the medicine for treating migraines called triptans for a long time?
translation: መድሃኒት ትሪፕታንስ ካብ ነዊሕ ጊዜ ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Have you been taking the medicine for treating migraines called Imigran only starting today?
translation: መድሃኒት ኢሚግራን ካብ ሎመዓልቲ ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Have you ever taken medicine to help with ulcers?
translation: መድሃኒት ናይ ጮጎራ ቁስሊ ወሲድካዶ ኣብ ዝሓለፈ ጊዜ?

english: Have you been taking the blood-thinner medicine called Pradaxa for two days?
translation: መድሃኒት ፕራዳክሳ ካብ ክልተ መዓልቲ ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Have you been taking anti-inflammatory medicine for more than ten hours?
translation: መድሃኒት ኣንጻር ቃንዛ ወይ ናህሪ ካብ ዓሰርተ ሰዓት ንላዕሊ ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Can you use your hand?
translation: ኢድካ ክትጥቅመሉዶ ትኽእል?

english: Have you been taking the anti-inflammatory medicine called ibuprofen for more than one month?
translation: መድሃኒት ኢቡፕሮፈን ካብ ሓደ ወርሒ ንላዕሊ ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: Has it hurt for two days?
translation: ካብ ክልተ መዓልቲ ኣትሒዙዶ የቐንዝወካ ?

english: Did you use medicine you put on your skin for several weeks?
translation: ኣብ ቆርበት ዝልከይ መድሃኒት ንብዙሕ ሰሙናትዶ ወሲድካ?

english: Have you been taking the beta-blocker medicine called Beloc for one hour?
translation: መድሃኒት በሎክ ካብ ሓደ ሰዓት ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: I will give you a prescription for the medicine to lower cholesterol called statins
translation: መድሃኒት ስታቲን ክእዝዘልካ እየ

english: Have you been taking medicine to lower your cholesterol for two days?
translation: መድሃኒት ኣንጻር ናይ ደም ስብሒ ወይ ኮለስተሮል ካብ ክልተ መዓልቲ ኣትሒዙ ትወስዶዶ ኣለኻ?

english: How much weight have you lost in the past six months?
translation: ክንደይ ክብደት ጎዲልካ ኣብ ዝሓለፈ ሹድሽተ ወርሒ?
